title: Dataiku
blurb: Enterprise platform pitching "the AI success formula" — people, process, tooling — used by SLB, J&J and Novartis.
body:
Dataiku positions itself around an "AI success formula" with people at the center — an enterprise platform for building, governing and scaling AI/analytics workflows.

Named enterprise case studies include SLB, Johnson & Johnson and Novartis. A useful reference point for the enterprise-AI-platform category (vs. the developer-CLI tools elsewhere in this base).

SOURCE · dataiku.com landing page.
